title: V-8 ENGINE 454 C.I.D. 3 X 2- DIVERTER VALVE & A.I.R. HOSES
summary: 454 3x2 (triple two-barrel) engine option LJ2: A.I.R. (smog/air injection) system: air pump pulley, diverter valve on an adapter bolted to the air pump, LH and RH hoses from the valve to the air injection manifold pipes along each exhaust manifold, and the vacuum signal hose from the carburetor. The pulley bolts to the pump hub; the adapter and diverter valve bolt to the pump with washers, one nut on a stud; the hoses are clamped. Many hardware pieces (marked A) assemble same as RPO LT1.

parts.name: PIPE ASM.
parts.name_expanded: A.I.R. injection pipe assembly (air manifold), LH

parts.name: R.H.
parts.name_expanded: A.I.R. injection pipe assembly (air manifold), RH

parts.name: HOSE L.H.
parts.name_expanded: A.I.R. hose, LH (diverter valve to LH pipe)

parts.name: HOSE R.H.
parts.name_expanded: A.I.R. hose, RH (diverter valve to RH pipe)

parts.name: ADAPTER ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Diverter valve adapter assembly (on air pump)

fastening.note: Bolts [4] go through the pulley [3] into the pump hub, from the front. Pulley carries a stamped part number (note B).
View A: adapter [10] bolts to the air pump outlet with a gasket between; bolt, plain washer and lock washer are A items (same as RPO LT1), no callout.
View A: diverter valve [6] mounts on the adapter [10] with a gasket; one bolt with plain + lock washer (A items, no callout) and one nut [9] with plain + lock washer (A) on a stud.

fastening.to: diverter valve [6] outlets and pipe assemblies [1] check valves
fastening.note: Hoses [2] (LH) and [7] (RH) have molded ends; clamped with A clamps (no callout) at the diverter valve and at the check valves (A VALVE) on the pipes [1].

fastening.to: carburetor vacuum fitting and diverter valve [6]
fastening.note: Signal hose [8] runs from the carburetor fitting (CARB) to the diverter valve vacuum nipple.
Pipe assembly [1] tube nuts thread into the heads; torque ref 2 shown at both callouts of [1]. Check valve (A VALVE) on the pipe.
Spacer [5] sits on the pump mounting stud, retained by an A nut (no callout); pump also held by an A bolt.

notes: [A] Part assembles same as RPO LT1
